kb.title: What is IPFX Capital?
kb.answer:
IPFX Capital Ltd is a UK-based proprietary trading firm (founded 2025, London) that runs trader evaluation programmes. You trade a simulated evaluation account on **IPFX Markets**, our trading platform. If you meet the rules you can progress to a funded account and earn a share of the profit — up to **{{p:trad_25k_p1.split_pct}}**.

We offer four programmes: the free **Infinity Challenge**, the **Traditional Challenge**, the **Futures Challenge** and the **Personalised Application Challenge (PAC)**. Ask me about any of them, or see the [About page](/about.html).

kb.title: How does IPFX work?
kb.answer:
1. **Create an account** and verify your email.
2. **Choose a programme** and submit an application (identity details and documents).
3. **Our team reviews it** — {{c:review_time}}. Nothing is charged and no account is created until you're approved.
4. **Trade on IPFX Markets.** The Infinity Challenge is free; Traditional and Futures are paid after approval.
5. **Meet the rules** (profit target, drawdown and daily loss limits, minimum days).
6. **Get funded** and request payouts — you keep {{p:trad_25k_p1.split_pct}} of the profit.

Evaluation accounts use virtual capital. Ask me for detail on any step.
follow_ups: What do I need to apply?

kb.title: Which programmes do you offer?
kb.answer:
- **[Infinity Challenge](/infinity.html)** — free to start, four stages from a $1,000 evaluation account to a professional funded account.
- **[Traditional Challenge](/start-challenge.html)** — {{p:trad_25k_p1.target_pct}} / {{p:trad_25k_p2.target_pct}} / {{p:trad_25k_p3.target_pct}} targets over three phases. Fees: {{fees:traditional}}.
- **[Futures Challenge](/futures.html)** — two phases ({{p:fut_25k_p1.target_pct}} then {{p:fut_25k_p2.target_pct}}), end-of-day trailing drawdown. Fees: {{fees:futures}}.
- **[Personalised Application Challenge (PAC)](/personalised-challenge.html)** — you disclose your strategy, our analysts backtest it and agree custom parameters. Entry fees: {{fees:pac}}.

All programmes need an approved application. Which would you like to know more about?
follow_ups: Tell me about the Infinity Challenge

kb.title: Which programme should I choose?
kb.answer:
I can't recommend one for your circumstances, but here's how they differ:

- **Infinity** — no fee, small starting capital ($1,000), four stages, stricter trade-level rules (1% risk per trade, daily profit cap in Stage 1).
- **Traditional** — paid, larger simulated accounts ($10K–$200K), three phases with static drawdown.
- **Futures** — paid, two phases, end-of-day trailing drawdown, aimed at CME futures traders.
- **PAC** — for traders who already have a documented, profitable strategy; custom parameters agreed with our analysts.

Compare the exact numbers with "What are the fees?" or "Compare the daily loss limits". Trading is risky and none of this is financial advice.
follow_ups: Is the Infinity Challenge really free?

kb.title: Is IPFX regulated by the FCA?
kb.answer: No. IPFX Capital Ltd is **not authorised or regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)** or any other financial regulator. We do not provide investment advice, and we sell an evaluation service rather than a regulated financial product. See section 2 of our [Terms](/terms.html) and the [Risk Disclosure](/risk-disclosure.html).

kb.title: Is it real money or a demo?
kb.answer:
- **Evaluation accounts are simulated** with virtual capital. None of your own money is placed in a market.
- The **challenge fee** (where there is one) pays for the evaluation service — it isn't a deposit or balance you can withdraw.
- **Funded accounts are owned by IPFX.** You never deposit into them; you trade the company's account under the agreed rules and receive a discretionary profit split.
- **Infinity Stage 4** is described as trading on live markets (A-book).

Prices on IPFX Markets are for simulated evaluation and may differ from live market prices. See sections 2 and 9 of the [Terms](/terms.html).

kb.title: Is IPFX legit? Can I trust IPFX?
kb.answer:
I can only give you facts rather than reassurance:

- IPFX Capital Ltd is registered in England & Wales and launched in 2025, so we're a young firm.
- Our [Terms](/terms.html), [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html) and [Risk Disclosure](/risk-disclosure.html) are public — please read them before you apply.
- We are **not FCA regulated**, and passing a challenge, getting funded or being paid is never guaranteed.
- Never pay anyone claiming to be IPFX outside our website checkout, and never share your password.

Only spend what you can afford to lose. You can leave an honest review on [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/evaluate/ipfxcapital.com); we never pay or reward anyone for reviews.

kb.title: Who runs IPFX? Who founded it?

kb.answer:
IPFX Capital was founded in 2025 by a team of traders, analysts and operators, based in London. Paul Adeniji is Co-Founder & CEO. The [About page](/about.html) describes the team (trading, quant & risk, technology, compliance & operations). I can't share personal contact details for team members — please use {{c:contact_email}}.

Our registered company number and registered-office address haven't been published on the website yet — if you need them, email {{c:contact_email}}.

kb.title: What do I need to apply?
keywords: what documents do i need to apply
kb.answer:

- your legal name, date of birth, phone number, address and nationality

- a valid, unexpired **photo ID** (passport, driving licence or national ID card)
- **proof of address** dated within the last 3 months (utility bill, bank statement or official letter)

Every application is reviewed by a person. See "Is my ID safe?" for how we protect your documents.

kb.title: How long does approval take? Why is approval needed?
kb.answer:
Every challenge application is reviewed by a member of our team, who decides Yes or No. We aim to decide **{{c:review_time}}** (the PAC's strategy review takes {{c:pac_review_time}}).

Until you're approved, **no payment is requested and no trading account is created**. Automated checks may flag issues for a person to look at, but they never make the final decision.

I can't see your individual application — if it's taking longer, email {{c:contact_email}} from your registered email address.

kb.title: What if my application is denied?
kb.answer: You'll see the decision (and a note where one is given) in your application status and by email. You can ask us to explain or reconsider a decision by emailing {{c:contact_email}}. Because I can't see individual applications, I can't tell you why a specific one was denied.

kb.title: What ID and documents do you accept? How does identity verification work?
keywords: what documents do i need to upload

We accept:

You upload them as part of your application (and can update them from your dashboard). Our team reviews them; if something is unclear or rejected you'll be told why and can upload again. KYC must also be verified before any payout. If you're asked for documents, please provide them within **{{c:kyc_deadline_days}} days**.

kb.title: Which countries are restricted? Can I use a VPN?

IPFX isn't available where our services are prohibited by law. Residents of **Canada (Ontario)** and any **OFAC-sanctioned country** are not eligible, and we can restrict other jurisdictions at any time. You're responsible for making sure using IPFX is lawful where you live.

Using a **VPN or proxy** to hide your location or get around a restriction is prohibited and can lead to account termination without refund. If you're unsure about your country, ask {{c:contact_email}} before applying.

kb.title: I didn't get my verification email

kb.title: Can I have more than one account or challenge?

Under that one account you can hold more than one challenge account, subject to our approval. kb.title: What happens if I fail an Infinity stage? How many attempts do I get?
kb.answer:
- **Stage 1:** if you breach a rule your account closes and you can start Stage 1 again — up to **{{p:infinity_s1.attempts}} attempts per calendar month**, free. A further attempt is available from the 1st of the next month.
- **Stage 2, 3 or 4:** breaching a rule resets you to a fresh Stage 1. Any held Stage 2 earnings that hadn't yet been released are forfeited.
- There's no payment or compensation for failing a stage.

You can only restart when you have no other active account.

kb.title: How do Infinity payouts work?
keywords: when do i get paid infinity
kb.answer:
- **Stage 2 earnings are held**, not paid when you finish Stage 2.
- In **Stage 3**, the moment your closed profit reaches **3%**, your Stage 2 earnings (your {{p:infinity_s2.split_pct}} share) are released as your first payout.
- Completing Stage 3 earns a **second payout** — {{p:infinity_s3.split_pct}} of your Stage 3 profit.
- After the quant review you move to Stage 4 with **bi-weekly** payouts.
- If you fail in Stage 2, 3 or 4 before the milestone, held earnings are forfeited.

Payouts also require verified KYC and are reviewed by our team.

kb.title: Why is there a daily profit cap in Stage 1?
kb.answer: Stage 1 counts at most **{{p:infinity_s1.cap_pct}} profit per day** ({{p:infinity_s1.target_amt}} target overall). It exists so a single lucky trade or day can't pass the stage — the result has to be repeatable across days. Profit above the cap on a day doesn't count towards the target. Losses always count in full.

kb.title: What is the quant review?
kb.answer: When you complete Stage 3 our quantitative team reviews your trading across Stages 1–3 — Sharpe ratio, drawdown behaviour, average risk-to-reward, position sizing consistency, session and instrument concentration, and whether results look like genuine edge or noise. It's completed **within 24 hours** and you're notified of the outcome. We can decline Stage 4 for traders who hit the numbers but whose pattern doesn't reflect systematic, repeatable skill.

kb.title: What is max drawdown (static vs trailing)?
keywords: how much can i lose before i fail
how much can i lose overall
kb.answer:
**Max drawdown** is the largest fall in equity allowed overall. There are three kinds:
- **Static** — measured from your *starting balance* and never moves (Traditional, PAC default).
- **Trailing** — measured from your *highest equity ever*, so it rises as you profit (Infinity Stages 1–3).
- **End-of-day trailing** — trails your highest *end-of-day* balance; intraday swings don't move it (Futures, Infinity Stage 4).

I can't see individual accounts — for a specific breach, email {{c:contact_email}} with your registered email.

kb.title: What trading practices are prohibited?
kb.answer:
The main prohibited practices (Terms section 8) are:
- **Arbitrage and latency exploitation** — tick scalping, exploiting price delays or feed differences
- **Hedging or coordinating across accounts** (yours or anyone else's)
- **Copy trading and signals** — copying, being copied, or letting anyone else trade your account
- **Unapproved bots/EAs** — algorithms need written approval first
- **Martingale, grid and aggressive averaging** (unless agreed for a PAC)
- **Single-trade gambling** or reverse-engineering the exact targets
- **Exploiting platform errors** (report them instead) and **VPN/location masking**
- **Account sharing** and multiple registered accounts

Breaches mean immediate closure with no refund. Read section 8 of the [Terms](/terms.html) for the full wording.
follow_ups: Can I use an EA or bot?

kb.title: Is scalping allowed?
keywords: how many trades can i place
is there a max number of trades per day
kb.answer:
Scalping as a style is fine, but **tick scalping and latency/arbitrage exploitation are prohibited**. For accounts opened on or after {{c:rules_v2_date}}:
- **Profit from a trade closed less than 60 seconds after opening doesn't count** towards your target (losses still count in full).
- No more than **5 new orders in any 10 seconds** — extra orders are rejected.
- Market orders have a short execution delay and slippage (see "What are the execution costs?").

kb.title: Can I use an EA or trading bot?
keywords: can i run my bot on your platform
kb.answer: Only through IPFX Markets, and only with written approval. Third-party software, EAs and any programmatic connection are prohibited unless you've submitted the full strategy (code, language, max risk per trade) via the designated tool and IPFX has **explicitly approved it in writing** — submission alone isn't approval. You stay responsible for everything the algorithm does. Personalised Application Challenge traders can agree algorithmic trading as part of their application.

kb.title: Is copy trading allowed?
kb.answer: No. Copy trading is **prohibited on every evaluation and funded account**, whether you're the follower or the source. It also covers acting on signals from Telegram/Discord/social accounts, using a "challenge passing" or account-management service, and having anyone direct your trades in real time. Every trade must be your own independent decision. Breaches lead to termination of all involved accounts with no refund or payout.

kb.title: Can I trade news or hold trades over weekends?
kb.answer: Unless your programme says otherwise you can hold positions overnight and over weekends (you carry the gap risk), and news trading is allowed. Where a programme specifies news windows, trades opened inside them may be cancelled and won't count. IPFX may restrict overnight or weekend holding in specific market conditions with reasonable notice. Also remember the daily loss limit includes floating losses carried past midnight.

kb.title: What leverage do you offer?
kb.answer: IPFX Markets uses **{{c:leverage}} leverage**. Position size is also limited by the per-trade risk rules on your programme and by maximum lot sizes. For accounts opened on or after {{c:rules_v2_date}} on programmes with a per-trade risk cap, the combined risk of all open positions (entry to stop-loss) may not exceed **three times** that cap.

kb.title: Which instruments can I trade?
What are the execution costs (slippage, commission, delay)?
kb.answer:
The platform is a simulation designed to behave like real markets. For evaluation accounts opened on or after **{{c:rules_v2_date}}** (and funded accounts arising from them):
- **Execution delay:** market orders and closes you initiate execute after up to one second, at the less favourable of the price when received and when executed.
- **Slippage:** applies to market orders, closes, stop-loss fills and triggered stops — currently up to about 0.3 basis points on forex, 0.5 on metals/indices and 5 on crypto. Take-profit and limit orders fill at their price or better.
- **Commission:** US$6 per standard lot round-turn on forex and metals; none on indices and crypto.
- **Stops aren't guaranteed** across gaps, and abnormal off-market prices may be disregarded.

Costs are shown on every trade in your history. Rates can change under the Terms (section 18).

kb.title: What trading platform do you use? MT4/MT5? Desktop app?
kb.answer: All trading happens on **IPFX Markets**, our own web platform (open it from your dashboard). MetaTrader 4/5, cTrader and other third-party platforms aren't supported. {{c:desktop_status}} Charts are built into IPFX Markets; prices are for simulated evaluation and may differ from live exchange prices.

kb.title: Are the prices real? Why are prices different?
kb.answer: IPFX Markets prices are suitable for **simulated evaluation** and are not represented as exchange tick-by-tick data, so they can differ from your broker or exchange. If a price looks wrong, don't trade on it — report it straight away to {{c:contact_email}} (exploiting a known platform error is prohibited and its profits are void). Orders are rejected when no fresh, reliable price is available.

kb.title: When can I trade? What are the market hours?
kb.answer: Each instrument follows its own trading sessions, shown in IPFX Markets — orders are rejected while a market is closed or no reliable price exists. The daily loss limit day runs 00:00–23:59 server time (UTC). Scheduled maintenance or outages can occur; see section 15.2 of the [Terms](/terms.html).

kb.answer:
You request payouts from the **Payouts** page of your dashboard once you have a funded account in good standing. To be eligible:
- your **identity (KYC) is verified**
- at least **{{c:payout_min_days}} days** since your last payout (or since the account was funded)
- the payout is at least **${{c:payout_min_usd}}**
- you pass the **consistency checks** (see "Is there a consistency rule?")
- no investigation or hold is open on the account

Every request is **reviewed by our team**; once approved it's typically processed in **{{c:payout_processing}}**. Payments go only to your own verified payout method. Your share is **{{p:trad_25k_p1.split_pct}}** of net profit. The very first payout has an extra profit threshold — see "What's needed for my first payout?".

kb.title: What's needed for my first payout?
keywords: when can i request my first payout
when is the earliest i can request my first payout
kb.answer:
Before your **first** payout on a funded account you must reach at least **{{c:first_payout_threshold_pct}}% net realised (closed) profit** on the funded starting balance — e.g. $1,250 on a $25,000 account. Floating profit doesn't count. It's a one-off requirement; later payouts follow the normal conditions.

Once you're eligible, your **challenge fee is added to your first profit-split payment** as a single combined payment (see "Is the fee refundable?").

kb.title: Why was my payout denied or withheld?
kb.answer:
Common reasons a payout request is refused or held:
- KYC isn't verified yet, or documents haven't been supplied within {{c:kyc_deadline_days}} days of a request
- fewer than {{c:payout_min_days}} days since the last payout, or under the ${{c:payout_min_usd}} minimum
- a consistency check failed (one trade above 25% of the period's profit; and on newer accounts, under 4 trading days or one day above 40%)
- an investigation/hold or unresolved rule breach on the account
- a force-majeure or security suspension

I can't look at your request. Email {{c:contact_email}} from your registered address with the payout date and amount (no documents or card details) and the team will check.

kb.title: How will I be paid? Do I pay tax?
kb.answer: You add a payout method on the **Payouts** page of your dashboard — currently **bank transfer, PayPal or wire**. Payments are made **only to your own verified method**, never to a third party, in USD, and timing can vary with the provider and your bank's country. Store a reference only (never a full card or account number). Methods can change, so email {{c:contact_email}} if you need to confirm one. You're **responsible for any tax** on payouts in your country; IPFX doesn't withhold tax unless the law requires it and can supply payment records on request. We can't give tax advice.

kb.title: Is the challenge fee refundable?
keywords: do i get my fee back
what happens to my fee if i pass
do i get my fee back if i pass
kb.answer:
- **Not refundable once activated:** once your evaluation account is activated and you've started trading, the fee is non-refundable, and your 14-day cancellation right ends.
- **Cancel before activating:** if you've paid but haven't placed any trade, you can cancel within **14 days** for a full refund — email {{c:contact_email}} *before* you trade.
- **Credited on your first payout:** when you reach your first payout eligibility (see "What's needed for my first payout?"), the fee for that programme is **added to your first profit-split payment**.
- No refund where a rule was broken, and please don't raise a chargeback (except for genuine fraud) — it leads to suspension.

The Infinity Challenge has no fee. See section 6 of the [Terms](/terms.html).
follow_ups: What's needed for my first payout?

kb.title: How can I pay? Which payment methods do you accept?
kb.answer: You pay **after** your application is approved, on the checkout step. Card payments are handled by our payment processor (we never see your full card details) and a crypto option is also available where enabled. {{c:checkout_note}} Fees are in US dollars; you cover any currency-conversion or bank charges, and taxes only where the law requires them.

kb.title: What are the fees? How much does it cost?

kb.title: Do you have promo codes or discounts?

The Infinity Challenge is always free to start.

kb.title: How does the referral programme work?
kb.answer:
Share your referral link from your dashboard. When someone you refer buys a challenge, gets funded and receives their **first payout**, you earn **{{c:referral_pct}}% of their challenge fee** as a reward.

Conditions: the friend must be a genuinely new customer using your link or code; self-referrals and rewards where you and the referred trader use the same network aren't paid; there's a default cap of 50 qualifying referrals per year unless the programme page says otherwise; and referrals must not be used for copy trading or signal-selling. Rewards can be withheld or reversed for fraud. See section 21 of the [Terms](/terms.html).

kb.title: Is my ID and personal data safe?

what do you do with my data

kb.answer: We collect your details only to review your application, run your account, pay you, prevent fraud and meet legal duties — and we **don't sell personal data**. Identity documents are kept in **private storage** (never in public folders), opened through short-lived links, and reviewed only by authorised staff with multi-factor authentication; access is logged. Data is encrypted in transit and protected by database access controls. No system is perfectly secure. Read the [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html) for full detail.

kb.title: How long do you keep my data? What are my data rights?
keywords: how long do you keep my documents
kb.answer:
- **Retention:** documents for an application that's denied, withdrawn or never activated are scheduled for review after **12 months**; for an approved challenge, after **5 years** (or the end of our relationship if later), unless a legal hold or investigation applies.
- **Your rights (UK GDPR):** access your data, correct it, request erasure, object to or restrict processing, get a portable copy, and withdraw consent.

Exercise them by emailing {{c:contact_email}} from your registered address. Some records must be kept for legal, fraud-prevention or dispute purposes.

kb.title: What cookies do you use?
kb.answer: We use essential storage for security, sessions and your consent choices. **Optional analytics stay off until you choose "Accept analytics"**, and you can change your mind any time using **Cookie settings** in the page footer. See the [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html).

kb.title: How do I keep my account secure?
kb.answer:
- Never share your password, login or access with anyone — sharing an account breaches the Terms.
- **IPFX will never ask for your password** or ask you to pay outside our checkout. Beware of fake emails, DMs or "account managers" using our name.
- Use a strong, unique password and reset it from the [login page](/login.html) if in doubt.
- If you suspect unauthorised access, email {{c:contact_email}} **immediately** — you're responsible for safeguarding your credentials.

kb.title: Who do you share my data with?
kb.answer: We share data only with providers needed to run the service — for example our database/authentication host (Supabase), our payment processor (Stripe, where enabled) and chart provider (where used) — and with law-enforcement or regulators where legally required. Where data leaves the UK we rely on adequacy decisions or standard contractual clauses. We don't sell your personal data. Details are in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html).

Note that closing the browser doesn't close open positions. If it persists, email {{c:contact_email}} with the time, the account, the instrument, and what you saw. If you believe a platform fault materially affected your evaluation, the Terms let IPFX extend it or issue a replacement at its discretion (section 6.4).

kb.title: How do I make a complaint or dispute a decision?

kb.title: How do I place a trade on IPFX Markets?

kb.title: Can I guarantee I'll pass or make money?

kb.title: Who can see my trades? Do you use my trading data?
kb.answer:
We record the trading data on your accounts (orders, sizes, prices, timings, balance history). It's used to run your account, calculate your results and payouts, enforce the rules and detect prohibited practices, and — in **aggregated, anonymised** form — to calibrate our risk models and improve the platform.

Under our Terms (section 11) we do **not** place, mirror or copy trades on any live account based on your individual, identifiable trading data. Any future programme that did would be a separate, clearly described opt-in with its own terms and compensation. For the PAC, your strategy disclosure is treated as confidential. See the [Privacy Policy](/privacy.html).
